summary: Use this page to check if a fireworks display has been approved in NSW.

external_links.text: Find New Year's Eve fireworks locations

faqs.q: Where can I find information about New Year's Eve fireworks?
faqs.a: You can find information about New Year's Eve fireworks in the City of Sydney section.

faqs.q: How can I search for fireworks displays across NSW?
faqs.a: You can search for fireworks across NSW using the Visit NSW link.

faqs.q: Where do I check for approved fireworks displays?
faqs.a: You can check for approved fireworks displays using the SafeWork NSW link.
